NWP SAF RTTOV spectral response functions

notes: Spectral response functions of the VISSR on GMS-2 (Himawari-2) (Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA)), from the EUMETSAT NWP SAF RTTOV spectral-response-function page rtcoef_gms_2_imager_srf.html (https://nwp-saf.eumetsat.int/site/software/rttov/download/coefficients/spectral-response-functions/); the owner's own file is not available online (see Sources). NWP SAF README: 'This file generated: 15/10/2019 README SRF: README file for GMS 2 VISSR imager filter response Last update March 1st 2017 SRF available at: http://www.data.jma.go.jp/mscweb/en/operation/response/gms2.txt'. Converted from wavenumber (cm-1) to wavelength (Angstrom, lambda = 1e8/sigma) and sorted; negative samples set to 0; scaled to peak 1. DetectorType=energy is assumed: the owner gives a normalised (relative) spectral response without stating photon or energy weighting; meteorological imager SRFs are applied as weights on spectral radiance (energy convention). SVO's archived records for these instruments carry DetectorType 0 (energy). Source: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA), via the EUMETSAT NWP SAF.
